Power Development Department Government of J&K, New secretariat, Jammu-180001 ..... **Respondents** _Order in IA 37-2020 in Petition No. 281/GT/2018_ _Page 2 of 3_ # ** ORDER ** Petition No. 15/RP/2020 has been filed by the Petitioner, NHPC seeking review of the Commission’s order dated 5.2.2020 in Petition No. 281/GT/2018 on the following grounds: - _(a) Reversal of Liability;_ - _(b) Restriction of additional capital expenditure to be carried out within original scope of work to Rs 8342.30 crore;_ - _(c) Interest on Loan; and_ - _(d) Operation and Maintenance Expenses_ 2. During the pendency of the review petition, the Petitioner has filed the instant Interlocutory Application (IA No.37/IA/2020) and has sought permission for amendment of the review petition by inclusion of certain additional grounds and facts related to NAPAF. The Petitioner has also deposited the filing fees of Rs 1.00 lakh for this IA. 3. In view of the aforesaid submissions, the Petitioner is permitted to amend the review petition and file the same on or before 22.6.2020. 4. The IA No.37/IA/2020 is disposed of in terms of the above. The Review Petition No.15/RP/2020 shall be listed for hearing on ‘admission’ on 25.6.2020. _Sd/Sd/Sd/-_ **(Arun Goyal) (I.S. Jha) (P.K. Pujari) Member Member Chairperson** _Order in IA 37-2020 in Petition No. 281/GT/2018_ _Page 3 of 3_
